values.features: 1. Large-arc track design following ergonomic movement paths, with double elbow pads that let users leverage their elbows, working the waist and core muscles more effectively. 2. Split slide rail design allows alternating climbing simulation, engaging the core muscles, with higher training intensity and more targeted workouts. 3. Extended curved track matches the body’s natural movement, making abdominal workouts more comfortable and efficient. 4. Made with solid materials for stable support, can hold up to 150 kg / 330 lbs, outperforming most home fitness equipment; thick padded cushions with non-slip handles provide ample support for knees and elbows. 5. Five levels of height adjustment suitable for beginners and fitness enthusiasts. Whether you want to build muscle strength or endurance, you can adjust the difficulty to match your training goals, achieving personalized workouts with one machine. 6. Equipped with an LCD screen to track reps, workout duration, and calories burned in real time, keeping your fitness progress clear.

LCD Monitor with Smart Features – Tracks time, count, calories burned, total count, and SPM (steps per minute). Equipped with Bluetooth connectivity and wireless heart rate monitoring. 6. Transport Wheels – Built-in wheels allow for easy movement and repositioning of the equipment. 7. Heavy-Duty Construction – Features a sturdy tripod-style frame with a maximum user weight capacity of 330 lbs.

TRANSPORTATION WHEELS: There are 2 built-in wheels on the bottom of front leg that makes movement easier. Enjoy a portable cardiovascular machine that can roll from room to room in your home for easy storage.

values.features: 1. Multi-Functional Integration Supports multiple workouts including crunches, planks, hip bridges, push-ups and more. One machine covers core, shoulder & back, glutes, and legs—replacing several single-purpose fitness tools. 2. Portable & Space-Saving Compact and foldable design with lightweight construction. Easy to store and use at home, in the office, or while traveling—no need for a dedicated workout area. 3. Safe & Ergonomic Support Built with anti-slip pads and ergonomic curved supports to reduce pressure on the lower back and wrists. Beginner-friendly design minimizes injury risks. 4. Efficient Fat-Burning & Sculpting Targets and strengthens core muscles, enhances waist and abdominal stability, and helps improve posture (including rounded shoulders or hunchback). Combines fat-burning effects with body-shaping benefits. 5. Low Entry Barrier & Easy to Stick With No professional training required. Adjustable resistance/angles fit various fitness levels. Ideal for office workers, new moms, and anyone who prefers short, flexible workout sessions.
